summary: A one-column pink page for Gnomon*, a WWII-poster display face built as two layers: a static foreground and a variable shadow font with custom 'Time of Day' (TOTD) and 'Shadow Distance' (DIST) axes. On load the shadow is set from the visitor's real clock (6:00→18:00 mapped onto TOTD 0→1000), hero sliders override it, and every section heading uses the same two-layer shadow, so the whole page is lit by the same 'sun'. The rest is a first-person essay in three chapters, one 'TRY ME!' input and a Download link.

instances.look: On flat bubblegum pink: a tiny tracked white line 'THE INDESTRUCTIBLE TYPE* COMPANY PRESENTS', then 'GNOMON*' huge in white with a hot-magenta extruded shadow (dark-magenta asterisk), then two full-width sliders labelled 'Time of Day: 1:41' and 'Shadow Distance: 100%' and a white 'Download' between two thick white rules
instances.ux: The shadow is already set to the visitor's local time on load; dragging 'Time of Day' swings the shadow around the letters like a sundial, 'Shadow Distance' lengthens or shortens it; both readouts update live and the sliders also restyle every section heading on the page
instances.learn: Bind a custom axis to something real (the visitor's clock) and expose it as a slider: the font becomes a live object and the slider becomes an explanation
